Image 2 = current in-game bars, image 3 = approved 'Smoke and Light' HUD material. Keep dry-brush stroke over smoky dark ink track with torn smoke edges and the warm glowing orb at the end of the fill; NOT a clean vector bar, NOT a metal/stone/ornate frame; no gems, plaque, name, icon, skull, no text but numbers.
